entities.summary: Sergei Aleksandrovich Kudryavtsev was a Ukrainian Soviet politician and statesman. He was born in Kharkiv. During the Great Purge, he was arrested on October 13, 1937, and later executed by firing squad. After the death of Joseph Stalin, he was rehabilitated in 1956.
